# SquareR

<!-- badges: start -->
<!-- badges: end -->

The goal of SquareR is to provide a simple and lightweight way to easily calculate the square and squareroot of any number.

## Installation

You can install the development version of SquareR like so:

``` r{install}
if(!require(remotes)){
    install.packages("remotes")
    library(remotes)
}
remotes::install_github("Liam-Bendzsa/SquareR", 
                         build_vignettes = TRUE)
```

## Example

The basics of how SquareR works:

```{r example}
library(SquareR)

squarer(16)
```
